$comment: Upstream observations from the goal board's PM rulings. Reported as observations, not diagnosed bugs, unless a minimal reproduction exists (reproduced: false).

observations.text: Keyboard activation with Space pressed before the Octane runtime has loaded was sometimes dropped, while pointer clicks at the same moment were replayed.
The SolidStart production build links a stylesheet that contains dev-toolbar styles; the toolbar script itself is not shipped.
The Ripple Vercel function measured about 18 MB on disk for a three-route app, because build tooling was traced into it.
Svelte does not replay input that arrives before hydration, so an early click on server-rendered markup can go unanswered on a slow network.
